import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0].strip())
    s = input_data[1].strip() if len(input_data) > 1 else ""
    
    arr = list(s)
    
    maxOutside = 0
    maxInside = 0
    currentLen = 0
    insideParen = False
    
    for ch in arr:
        if ch == '(':
            if currentLen > 0:
                maxOutside = max(maxOutside, currentLen)
            currentLen = 0
            insideParen = True
        elif ch == ')':
            if currentLen > 0:
                maxInside += 1
            currentLen = 0
            insideParen = False
        elif ch == '_':
            if insideParen:
                if currentLen > 0:
                    maxInside += 1
                currentLen = 0
            else:
                if currentLen > 0:
                    maxOutside = max(maxOutside, currentLen)
                currentLen = 0
        else:
            currentLen += 1
    
    if currentLen > 0:
        maxOutside = max(maxOutside, currentLen)
    
    print(f"{maxOutside} {maxInside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
